title: [Lean] Write prepared XOR into an existing paired tape block
body:
## Coverage

Explicit author-checked context: upstream main 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea; kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. These generic machines do not establish or change the selected exponent.

Two unchanged checked modules implement finite-symbol target-track writeback and connect the actual prepared XOR output through one charged controller transition. The destination's other track and all four original/work tapes are retained.

Finite coverage: arbitrary equal-width paired source/destination blocks, including zero width. The primitive returns both heads and clears scratch in exactly 7n+9 transitions with at most 2n+4 represented cells. The six-tape prepared pipeline has genuine first halt at most 25n+34, n=max input widths; actual entrance volume V gives time at most 25V and every-prefix cells at most 73V.

Conditional-interface coverage: supplied encoded Boolean words, marked existing destination of exactly the required capacity, pristine preparation workspaces and reached isolated slot entrance. Destination target bits and incoming scratch are overwritten/cleared, not reversibly restored. No allocation or key lookup is silently supplied.

Full-theorem coverage: ambient packed-slot access/framing, operand-field representation, resizing, dirty history restoration, recursive accounting and the full selected multiplication/runtime theorem remain open. Finite-alphabet represented cells are not a free arbitrary-integer encoding.

## Evidence and reproduction

Twelve standard-only axiom probes and four complete printed types were accepted by local Lean 4.21.0 checks and independent source/terminal reviews, without diagnostics. The public manifest binds exact source bytes, theorem scopes and prerequisite hashes. REPRODUCE.md contains prospective fresh-scratch commands. No extra local CI preflight, relocated replay, installer or archive build was run for submission.

Reuse ten unchanged public prerequisites without copying them: PR1921 at 69fefa9c2b2d3e5aa9bc11537537fd25ed3ea72c, PR1840 at 3f1b0641d5866f9d0b6cdd8e46db416fed6c5645, and PR488 at 34eb901441affffaba76b00920f2f9cb05777117. Historical PR488 context and its existing deprecation warnings remain provenance.

## Bounded overlap and attribution

PR565 at 890b2906ebb76b3c9392a08d64e933630c06b1ac compacts/copies a counter into pristine output. PR488 prepares work copies, and PR1921 produces a fresh paired XOR block. This chunk writes one track of an existing paired block while retaining the other and charges the enclosing handoff. No first-copy, global novelty or optimality claim is made. OVERLAP.json records the bounded comparison.

James Chang with OpenAI assistance; Apache-2.0. Existing source notices, prerequisite credits and Lean core attribution are retained.
